name: Promo Price Smash

behavior.description: A large price drops toward its authored baseline, compresses through a brief undershoot, then rebounds once to its final readable size. Only the price moves.
behavior.targetSelection: Animate matching price hooks within the selected component together; prefix, suffix, old-price and surrounding layout remain untouched.
behavior.keyframeTiming: at is seconds from start; easing at a keyframe applies until the next keyframe.

adaptation: x/y are offsets in design pixels at 1080x1920, scaled with the frame; positive y is down. Scale multiplies authored base scale and rotation adds a degree offset, preserving rotated impact variants. Opacity is absolute. Do not alter price text, number formatting, typography, decorative clipping or layout dimensions. Compose motion on a layout-preserving layer for inline prices. Initialize at scheduled start and sample from local time; the final price remains still and readable.
